checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use this skill when handling errors and halting requests in Hanami 2.x Actions.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Core principle:** Fail fast and return meaningful error responses. Never swallow exceptions or leak internal details.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Use `halt` for early returns**:

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Halt immediately with a status code and response body for early returns. Do not rely on default success status codes (e.g. 200) for error conditions.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: > **Common Mistake:** Match the error response format to the action format. Do not use `halt` with HTML error pages/strings in a JSON API action.

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Always rescue `StandardError` (never rescue `Exception` as it catches system-level interrupts like `SIGTERM` or `NoMemoryError`). Log full backtraces internally, but return generic messages externally. Never rescue exceptions silently.

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Do not manually inspect `request.params.valid?` or duplicate validation inside `#handle`. The action automatically halts with `422 Unprocessable Entity` before `#handle` runs if params validation fails.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Always write tests asserting on expected HTTP error status codes (e.g., 404, 422, 500) and verified error payload shapes.
